resolution.note: Fixed BarrelList index translation, insert clamping, pop on emptied last sublist

title: BarrelList indexing and insertion go wrong once it is split into sublists
body: Bug: after BarrelList(range(30000)) has been mutated (bl.pop(0); bl.insert(0, 0)) so that it holds several sublists: bl[len(bl)] returns an element from the middle instead of raising IndexError; bl.insert(len(bl), 'x') inserts mid-list instead of appending (insert past either end must clamp like list.insert); and pop() raises IndexError on a non-empty list after indexed pops emptied the last sublist.
